Your consoles

Paired consoles appear here.

Get your PlayStation ready

  1. Turn the console on, or put it in rest mode. Keep it on the same network as this device.
  2. On the console open Settings → System → Remote Play and switch Enable Remote Play on.
  3. Choose Link Device. It shows an 8-digit code. You type that code here, once.

    Interpolation engine Experimental

    Turns the picture right away when you move the mouse, before the console has answered. It learns how your game responds and switches itself off when it cannot tell.

    Frame diagnostic

    While a game is streaming, records how many frames the console sends and how many are new pictures (a game that runs below the stream's rate repeats pictures). Saved to the logs folder.

    PS4 consoles always stream H.264 regardless of the codec setting.

    Checking…

    PlayStation Network Experimental

    Finds your PS5 through your PSN account and registers it over the internet, for consoles that refuse the 8-digit code. The console must be on (or in rest mode) and signed in to your account.

    Sign in to PlayStation in your browser, then open ca.account.sony.com/api/v1/ssocookie and copy all of the text it shows. Paste it here. It is used once to get access and is not stored; the box is emptied as soon as you press Connect. Never share it: it gives access to your whole PlayStation account.

      Activity

      What the app has been doing. Nothing here leaves your computer.

        OpenPS

        Keyboard

        F
        Toggle full screen while streaming (when keys & mouse are off; use the button otherwise)
        M
        Mute or unmute while streaming (when keys & mouse are off)
        F10
        Turn keyboard and mouse control on or off; F7 next profile, F11 release everything, F8 open the key editor
        Esc
        Show the stream controls / leave full screen
        Tab
        Move between controls; everything is reachable from the keyboard
